negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovenian for investor-relations pages ('odnosi z vlagatelji', 'za vlagatelje') for the foreign-owned subsidiaries in this cell — OTP banka SI, Intesa Sanpaolo Bank, UniCredit Banka Slovenija, Addiko SI, Sparkasse, Gorenjska banka.
negative_findings.result_summary: None of them operates an IR page in the listed-issuer sense. Their disclosure surface is a documents/reports page plus a press room. Only Delavska hranilnica and DBS maintain investor-style sections, because they have dispersed domestic shareholders / listed debt.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must not assume IR pages, earnings calls, or transcripts for this cell. Cadence is annual (report) + episodic (press), with the exception of UniCredit SI's quarterly razkritja and Addiko's listed parent.

negative_findings.description: Checked SKB banka d.d. Ljubljana against the Bank of Slovenia supervised-entity register.
negative_findings.result_summary: SKB was removed from the register on 22.8.2024 following its merger into OTP banka d.d. The skb.si PDF archive still resolves in search results but is a legacy asset with no new filings.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Tracking SKB as a live source will yield permanent silence and may be misread as a dead-site failure. It should be archived once and reclassified as historical; forward coverage rolls into OTP banka d.d.

negative_findings.description: Searched specifically for a standalone Pillar 3 / CRR Part 8 document for SKB banka and for Gorenjska banka in Slovenian ('razkritja', 'razkritja dodatnih informacij').
negative_findings.result_summary: For SKB no separate Pillar 3 PDF surfaced — disclosures appear folded into the annual report. For Gorenjska banka a 'dodatna-razkritja' PDF exists but the search result was an older (2021-path) file; the current-year equivalent was not directly observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pillar 3 granularity varies by issuer in this cell; a uniform Pillar-3-first collection rule would fail. Some banks require parsing the annual report to reach the same tables.

negative_findings.description: Deželna banka Slovenije and Delavska hranilnica each returned two parallel URL generations/domains for the same content (dbs.si /o-nas/ vs /o-banki/; dh.si vs delavska-hranilnica.si).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both variants appear in current search results; which is canonical was not determined and is not claimed here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collectors keyed to the non-canonical path risk silent 404s that look like source death. Canonicalisation should be resolved in the deterministic verification pass, not assumed.

negative_findings.description: The cell rationale predicts these private/foreign-owned banks bypass public procurement portals; no attempt within this workstream (A1) surfaced any tender-portal presence for them.
negative_findings.result_summary: No public tender surface identified for any bank in this cell; vendor/technology signals must be inferred from press releases, annual report narrative sections, and parent-group presentations.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that press rooms and annual reports carry disproportionate weight for this cell and should be collected in full text, not just headline metrics.

coverage_gaps.description: Only Addiko's listed parent was worked through. The IR/segment surfaces of OTP Bank Nyrt. (Budapest), Intesa Sanpaolo / Privredna banka Zagreb, UniCredit S.p.A., Erste Group / Steiermärkische Sparkasse, and AIK banka / Agri Europe Cyprus were not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated parent-IR sweep: for each parent, locate the quarterly results presentation and the country/segment appendix where Slovenia appears, plus the parent's own press room for Slovenia-specific announcements.

coverage_gaps.description: Parent-group disclosure for these subsidiaries is often published first in Hungarian (OTP), Italian (Intesa, UniCredit) or German (Erste/Steiermärkische), and Serbian for AIK. This pass used only sl and en, per run scope.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Flag to the run owner whether the language scope should be widened for parent-side sources; if not, accept a lag on parent announcements and rely on the English IR versions.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom feed, sitemap, or API was confirmed for any press room in this cell; several sites are WordPress (gbkr.si, phv.si) where a /feed/ endpoint is plausible but unverified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Have the deterministic pass probe /feed/, /rss, and /sitemap.xml on each issuer domain to convert listing-page scraping into feed subscription where possible.

coverage_gaps.description: Hranilnica LON d.d. Kranj was named in the ZBS membership list but no dedicated search hit was obtained for its reports/disclosures page in this pass; the cell's 'savings banks' scope is therefore incomplete.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted local-language search for 'Hranilnica LON letno poročilo razkritja' and its own domain; add to the actor map alongside Delavska hranilnica and Primorska hranilnica Vipava.

coverage_gaps.description: AJPES JOLP documentation states online access covers only the last five years, with older reports obtainable only at AJPES offices; several issuer sites (gbkr.si, phv.si) host older PDFs under dated upload paths with no visible index.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Prioritise a one-off deep archival snapshot of issuer PDF directories now, and treat AJPES as a rolling 5-year window rather than a historical archive.

coverage_gaps.description: Only OTP banka's dedicated ESG/trajnostno poročanje page was identified; CSRD/sustainability statements for the other entities were not systematically located, and Delavska hranilnica's sustainability disclosure is noted as voluntary and limited in scope.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a sl-language sweep on 'trajnostno poročilo', 'poročilo o trajnostnosti', 'nefinančno poročilo' across all cell entities, since CSRD phase-in will make these a growing disclosure surface.

brief: Slovenia's unlisted and foreign-owned banks have no investor-relations layer to speak of: their disclosure is a Slovenian-language annual report PDF, a CRR 'razkritja' document that is sometimes standalone (Intesa Sanpaolo, UniCredit, Addiko, Sparkasse, Gorenjska) and sometimes folded into the annual report, and a press room that carries everything else. Cadence is therefore annual plus episodic, with two exceptions worth exploiting: UniCredit Banka Slovenija publishes quarterly razkritja, and Addiko's Vienna-listed parent reports Slovenia as a country segment every quarter. Cross-entity comparability and small-subsidiary discovery come from three pointer layers rather than the banks themselves — AJPES JOLP for statutory filings, SEOnet for the debt-listed (DBS bonds), and the Bank of Slovenia supervised-entity register, which is also what reveals structural change such as SKB's deletion on 22.8.2024 after merging into OTP. The main structural risk to coverage is treating the merged or renamed as merely silent, and the main open gap is the parent-group side: OTP Nyrt., Intesa/PBZ, UniCredit S.p.A., Erste/Steiermärkische and AIK were not yet swept.
